title: Rust: SCHC complete
description: Complete SCHC in Rust (lichen-schc). Missing: some headers/context per project-LICHEN-qopb. Includes: rules 1-6, fragmentation, context matching. Pass shared test vectors.
notes: Acceptance audit complete. Existing accumulated Rust implementation covers Rule Set v3 rules 0-7 plus 255, generic contexts/header profiles, canonical compress/decompress, OSCORE and authenticated link integration, ACK-on-Error fragmentation/reassembly/retry/replay/error atomicity, and bounded no_std operation. Fixed the discovered validation gaps: adaptation-vector helper strict-clippy lint; fuzz package workspace isolation; stale profile/rule/receiver APIs; production compress/decompress roundtrip coverage; all-length decompression input coverage. Evidence: cargo test -p lichen-schc --all-features initially PASS 159/159; after changes every Rule5 test passed individually under 15s and all Rule6/version/shared binaries passed under 30s; cargo check --no-default-features PASS; main all-target/all-feature clippy -D warnings PASS; authenticated-DIO and tile-sizing generators --check PASS; fuzz manifest check/build/clippy PASS and 2,000 smoke inputs per each of three targets PASS. Direct rustfmt --check and git diff --check PASS. Nested cargo fmt manifest command itself times out in cargo-fmt, but direct rustfmt proves changed files formatted and no test hangs were found.
close_reason: Complete: full Rust SCHC v3 acceptance and shared vectors pass; broken fuzz gates repaired
